policies.B7: Rapid response verification is attained if a vendor maintains an average response time of 20 minutes or less, or possesses SOC 2 Type II compliance.
policies.B8: System stability validation is confirmed if a service provider exhibits an uptime rating of 99.5 percent or higher, or maintains yearly cyber insurance coverage of $3,000,000 or more.
policies.B9: Tier-1 operational status is conferred on a vendor that secures system stability validation and obtains rapid response verification.
policies.B10: Fiscal stability certification is granted to a commercial partner that generates gross annual revenue of $5,000,000 or greater.
policies.B11: Official procurement clearance requires a contractor to hold a commercial vendor license.
policies.B12: Adequate staffing validation is achieved by maintaining an active staff count of at least 30 full-time employees.
policies.B13: Governance compliance approval is assigned to an enterprise that completes 10 or more internal compliance audits annually.
